generations.prompt: classic black and white soccer football, white leather panels with black pentagons connected by dark seams, spherical shading, small top-left highlight, crisp pixel art sprite

generations.role: rotation set (frames 0-7 of one revolution; PixelLab consistency via animate_image seeded from the selected master frame)
generations.action: soccer ball spinning in place around its vertical axis, black pentagon panels travelling smoothly around the sphere, one full revolution over the animation, ball stays perfectly centered with identical size every frame, no bouncing, no squashing, camera fixed

manual_cleanup: integer recentring of each frame to the master centroid (raw frames wandered +-1 px)
master silhouette alpha mask enforced on every frame (silhouette bit-identical across phases; killed two edge artifacts on frames 7-8)
interior holes filled from nearest opaque neighbour
palette quantized to the target set; final frames use 5 colours: #FFFFFF #F1F2EF #D1D4D1 #A7ACA9 #252929 (deepest #101313 unused after quantization)
